pilot_purpose: No-peek plumbing, candidate-rate, feed-stability and variance-estimation pilot; not a confirmatory edge test
candidate_universe: Unique SMC candidates recorded after the runtime four-hour same-direction nearby-entry cooldown

common_evaluation.execution_label: direction-correct bid/ask barrier replay; midpoint fixed-spread fallback prohibited for this experiment
common_evaluation.uncertainty_method: weekly block bootstrap with label-overlap diagnostics

power_disclosure.interpretation: A null is inconclusive and a positive point estimate is exploratory; separately power any later confirmatory experiment.

baseline_v1.description: All BUY and SELL candidates in the frozen candidate universe

buy_liquidity_v1.description: BUY candidates with a point-in-time 1H downside liquidity sweep

reset_rule: Any membership, source, feature, cost, lifecycle or evaluation change requires a new experiment version and resets the affected forward clock
